tools.name: scan_draft
tools.description: Scan a draft for the patterns that make writing read as AI-generated: banned vocabulary, structural tells (triplets, negation formulas, summary closers, colon chains, flat rhythm), and pattern density scored against the accumulation threshold. Deterministic — the same text always returns the same fi

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_draft · Public sink: scan_draft · Destructive: scan_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_draft · Public sink: scan_draft · Destructive: scan_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
